Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Skyward's infra and security teams asked me to pull together a short checklist of the commercial items they'll need to sign off on for a VPC/on‑prem deployment. The key asks from procurement are:

- Clear split of upfront license vs platform fee (and whether platform fee is invoiced annually or amortized)
- Support tiers (SLA, included SRE hours, optional on‑call) and unit pricing for add‑ons
- Any volume or term discounts (1yr vs 3yr commit) and an example price table for 3 typical sizing bands (pilot, production small, production large)
- Statement of Work (SOW) skeleton and timing for an implementation credit if we commit to a 24–36 month term
- Required evidence for compliance (SOC2 artifacts) and data residency notes

Can you send a short checklist + ballpark numbers we can share with our CFO and procurement by EOD Monday? We may loop in our legal team after that. I attached a CSV export of their internal chargeback model (they asked for an example mapping).

Also copying Tom from ProcureCorp who will manage the vendor checklist on their side.

Elena — thanks for the clear asks. I've put together a short checklist and ballpark commercial options below (high level — I'll follow up with a detailed SOW draft and a chargeback example matching their CSV). Attaching a working SOW draft and a simple chargeback table we can adapt.

Quick checklist (what to share with CFO / procurement):
1) Pricing components
   - Per‑node license: one‑time perpetual license per licensed node (list price + negotiation). Example: $62k per licensed node (pilot), $47k / node (production volumes).
   - Platform fee: annual fee for control plane & orchestration — billed annually or can be amortized over term at customer request (typical: $120k/year for small production; scales).
   - Support tiers: Standard (business hrs triage + 4hr P1 SLA), Premium (24/7 + 1hr P1 + 50 SRE hrs/year), Premier (dedicated SRE + on‑call blocks).
2) Example discounts
   - 1yr: baseline pricing
   - 3yr commit: 12–20% off combined list depending on commit and prepay cadence; additional implementation credit (one‑time) for 3yr prepay (we typically offer a 10–20% implementation credit off platform fee on multi‑year prepay).
3) Packaging options to propose
   - Option A (Pilot): 1‑3 licensed nodes, platform fee (starter), Standard support; 30% pilot discount on license line if pilot converts within 6 months.
   - Option B (Production small): 10 licensed nodes, amortized platform fee, Premium support; 15% term discount on licenses + implementation credit.
   - Option C (Prod large / multisite): 50+ nodes, negotiated blended pricing, Premier support, architecture review & onboarding retainer.
4) Compliance evidence
   - We can provide SOC2 Type II report, pen test summary, and data residency attestation.
5) SOW milestones
   - Kickoff -> Install -> Integrations -> Validation -> Handover; typical pilot -> production timeline 6–12 weeks depending on integrations and SRE availability.

Next steps:
- I'll send an editable SOW and a chargeback mapping (attached). Marissa — can you review the discount bands and confirm if we can stretch to 22% for a 3yr prepay if they take Premier? Ben — can you provide the SRE hour rates and on‑call uplift so I can add them to the table?

If Elena and Tom want a short call Monday morning, I can walk through the numbers and proposed packaging.

Thanks,
Marcus

Elena — thanks, Marcus. High level thoughts / edits inline:

> 1) Pricing components
>    - Per‑node license: one‑time perpetual license per licensed node (list price + negotiation). Example: $62k per licensed node (pilot), $47k / node (production volumes).

Would suggest we present license as either "per licensed node" or "per seat equivalent" depending on their ops model; some customers prefer a per‑GPU license, others per‑site. For Skyward, given they shared the chargeback CSV, per‑site node license maps easier.

> 2) Example discounts
>    - 1yr: baseline pricing
>    - 3yr commit: 12–20% off combined list depending on commit and prepay cadence; additional implementation credit (one‑time) for 3yr prepay (we typically offer a 10–20% implementation credit off platform fee on multi‑year prepay).

We can be flexible to 22% for a 3yr if they take Premier + 50% prepay at signature. Need to flag this requires finance approval (I can route).

> 3) Packaging options to propose
>    - Option C (Prod large / multisite): 50+ nodes, negotiated blended pricing, Premier support, architecture review & onboarding retainer.

Add a small note: for multisite with cross‑region replication we charge an additional regional control plane uplift.

Ben — can you confirm SRE retainer pricing and added on‑call uplift so Marcus can finalize the table? I'm happy to draft the commercial summary that aligns with their CSV and return a 1‑page CFO friendly table.

Marcus — couple of procurement asks to anticipate:
- Can platform fee be invoiced quarterly after initial setup? (some finance teams insist on quarterly for OpEx)
- Are there limits to OS/hypervisor compatibility we should declare explicitly in SOW?

Elena / Tom — if Monday AM works for you, we'd propose a 30‑minute call to walk a single page commercial table and the SOW milestones.

Best,
Marissa

- Implementation credit: they want language that the credit is contingent on conversion to production within 9 months of installation — is that acceptable?
